scope: B round 100 executed Train profiles only; no Validation or Test payloads
clock_definition: seconds elapsed since controller initialization at sample first timestamp; source time_s is verified against timestamps; includes real elapsed shore time
clock_not_claimed: physical mission start or remaining mission time; sample reset comes from offline trimming
clock_model_input: lookup only elapsed_seconds[sample][zero-based archive ONBOARD transition index], divided by a declared fixed time scale; source row, sample identity, dates, array length, duration and future row values must never be policy inputs
next_clock_mapping: for a nonterminal n-step window, elapsed_seconds[sample][sourceIndex+m]; terminal tuples never bootstrap

ais_train_totals.causal_status: PCHIP uses future brackets; nearest within plus/minus 10 seconds can select a future raw record; neither source timestamp nor signed offset is retained by sidecar

limitations: speed available in FormalEpisode but frozen sidecar is not certified causal and is not in current 7-feature state
position, heading, mission plan, destination, planned deadline and physical end signal have no fields in FormalEpisode or supplied mode/AIS sidecar schema
longer history is causal at the simulation observation boundary but its predictive sufficiency has not been established
a clock can statistically separate sampled states without making variable unknown horizons Markov or proving real online mission observability
